_about: States baked into the final dev test zip (docs: CLAUDE.md, 'Final dev build'). Each game: its releases as No-Intro names (checked against src/dumps_data.h), each with slots 1-9 -> [fixture state in gba-ds-tests/states/<game>/, what to check]. tools/make_device_states.py writes <name>.slotN.state files; scripts/build-rocknix.sh puts them in the zip's states/ folder when GBADS_DEVICE_STATES names the output folder.

1: us-field.ss
World map, two characters (hacked save, no Sight caster): party screen, no command list, no hand (FF4-3)
2: World map with Rosa in the party: the Sight map, black either side (FF4-8)
3: The Moon's surface: its map from Sight (FF4-8)
4: A cave where Sight can't be cast: party screen (FF4-3)
5: Lunar Subterrane, five characters, green window colour: party screen in the game's colour (FF4-3)
6: START's menu open on the game screen: second screen shows the same as walking about (FF4-6)
7: A battle loaded straight in: logo. Load slot 1 first, wait for the party, then load this: the party stays (FF4-4)

4: Save point's message box: logo; after slot 1, the party stays (FF4-5)
5: Everyone down, after slot 1: party through the defeat message, logo at the title (FF4-4, FF4-2; known issue)
